newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper prices ease on state firm offers.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper prices ease on state firm offers.

text.p: Indian copper prices eased on Friday while other base metals moved in a narrow range and ended unchanged, dealers said.
Ready copper fell by 100 rupees to 12,200 rupees per quintal on sluggish physical demand and higher offerings by the state-owned Hindustan Copper Ltd, one dealer said.
Nickel was steady at 39,500 rupees on stray support from the stainless steel industry. Tin was unchanged at 36,000 rupees, zinc at 6,300 rupees and lead at 4,900 rupees, respectively.
The markets were closed on Thursday for a Hindu festival.
